# UP Scholarship

> upscholarships.in is an independent educational information website primarily focused on UP Scholarship and UP Scholarship 2026-27. The website provides clear, practical and easy-to-understand information about UP Scholarship OTR, registration, online application, login, status, last date, renewal, payment, correction, eligibility, documents, PFMS, NPCI and other student-related scholarship guidance. Content is available in both Hindi and English on the website.

This site does not process applications, registrations or payments directly. Students must apply and manage their scholarship through the official portal linked below.

## Main UP Scholarship Guide

- [UP Scholarship 2026-27](https://upscholarships.in/): Complete guide to UP Scholarship 2026-27, including OTR Registration, Apply Online, Login, Last Date, Status Check, Renewal, Payment, Correction, Eligibility, Documents and important updates.

## UP Scholarship OTR

- [UP Scholarship OTR Registration 2026-27](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-otr/): Step-by-step guide for UP Scholarship OTR Registration, Mobile Number Authentication, Aadhaar e-KYC and OTR Number generation.

- [UP Scholarship OTR Number Recovery](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-otr-number-forgot-recover/): Guide for students who have forgotten or lost their UP Scholarship OTR Number and want to recover it.

## UP Scholarship Registration & Application

- [UP Scholarship Registration 2026](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-registration/): Complete guide to UP Scholarship Fresh Registration and online application for Pre-Matric, Intermediate and Post-Matric students.

- [UP Scholarship Last Date 2026-27](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-last-date/): UP Scholarship Fresh and Renewal application dates, correction dates, hard-copy submission dates and payment schedule.

## UP Scholarship Status & Payment

- [UP Scholarship Status 2026](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-status/): Guide to checking UP Scholarship Fresh, Renewal, Application, Verification and Payment status.

- [PFMS Status for UP Scholarship 2026](https://upscholarships.in/pfms-status-up-scholarship/): Guide to checking UP Scholarship payment and DBT status through PFMS.

- [NPCI Aadhaar Bank Linking for UP Scholarship](https://upscholarships.in/npci-aadhaar-bank-linking-up-scholarship/): Information and guidance about Aadhaar-bank linking, NPCI seeding and DBT payment requirements.

## UP Scholarship Student Help

- [UP Scholarship Old Registration Number](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-old-registration-number-find/): Guide for students who have forgotten or lost their previous UP Scholarship Registration Number.

- [UP Scholarship Helpline Number 2026](https://upscholarships.in/up-scholarship-helpline-number/): UP Scholarship helpline, contact information and guidance for common application, status and payment-related problems.

## Student Information

UP Scholarships provides educational information and step-by-step guidance to students regarding UP Scholarship procedures, online applications, OTR, registration, status checking, renewal, payment, correction, eligibility, required documents and related student services.

The website aims to explain government scholarship procedures in simple Hindi and English so that students can understand the process and complete the required steps correctly.

This site is updated regularly whenever new UP Scholarship notifications, dates or portal changes are announced. Important dates, eligibility requirements, procedures and government rules may change. Students should verify important information with the latest official notification and the official Uttar Pradesh Scholarship portal.

## Official Government Portal

- [UP Scholarship Official Portal](https://scholarship.up.gov.in/): Official Uttar Pradesh Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Online System. All applications, registrations and payments must be completed here, not on upscholarships.in.

## Related Scholarship Information

- [UP Sanskrit Scholarship 2026-27](https://upscholarships.in/up-sanskrit-scholarship/): Information about UP Sanskrit Scholarship 2026-27, including application, eligibility, important dates, status and payment.
